basis: NAMMCO reported coastal-ecotype average; selected nominal adult-size candidate, not measured age/sex/specimen
asset_license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 per source/license.txt and glTF extras
provenance_warning: Top-level asset license.txt incorrectly identifies DigitalLife Model 61A; preserved for review, not used as provenance here.
measurement: Z-projected rostrum-tip to centreline fluke-notch candidate, after complete parent transforms and fixed model rotation; not curved body length

fluke_notch_candidate.review: mean of symmetric near-centreline posterior notch vertices; provisional anatomical selection

waterline.policy: Keep GAMA origin depth unchanged. Check whole mesh maximum Y; no automatic ocean-following offset.
waterline.supported_pose: static shallow_swim; not a breathing/surface pose
waterline.blowhole_clearance: Not certified: blowhole landmark not positively identified; report whole-mesh submergence instead.
waterline.waves: Mean-plane clearance is not instantaneous clearance from animated wave troughs/crests.

uncertainties: Original specimen size, age, sex and ecotype unknown; morphology is illustrative.
Fluke-notch candidate needs expert anatomical review.
Axial landmark metric is not claimed identical to every literature measurement protocol.
No dynamic buoyancy, breathing clearance or skeletal animation calibrated.
